Healthy.description: No visible disease symptoms in this image.
Healthy.when_to_seek_help: If symptoms appear later, consult a local agricultural extension officer.

RedRot.description: A fungal disease of sugarcane (Colletotrichum falcatum).
symptoms: Reddening with white patches inside stalks
causes: Fungus Colletotrichum falcatum, often spread through infected seed cane
management: Follow local recommendations for any chemical treatment; product and dosage must follow official labels
RedRot.when_to_seek_help: Contact your local agricultural officer if several plants are affected.

management: Follow local recommendations for fungicides and official labels
Rust.when_to_seek_help: Seek expert help if spread is rapid.

Mosaic.description: A viral disease causing mosaic patterns on leaves.
symptoms: Light and dark green mottling on leaves
causes: Sugarcane mosaic virus, spread by aphids and infected setts
Mosaic.when_to_seek_help: Consult an expert before replanting from affected fields.

symptoms: Yellowing of the leaf midrib and blade
causes: Sugarcane yellow leaf virus; nutrient or water stress can look similar
management: Confirm the cause with an expert
Yellow.when_to_seek_help: Symptoms resemble nutrient stress; get a professional diagnosis.

causes: Bacterial infection; wet conditions favor spread
management: Remove infected leaves; follow local guidance
